# ToD scripted NEW GAME from a fresh hdd0, in-level inputs anchored to Metropolis' control start (R&C patch 7062;
# tools/pad/tods-newgame-play.txt is the same script on wall-clock seconds, for builds without 7062).
# Menu part on seconds since the first pad poll (timings from tods-scr-x1, 2026-11-10):
# START 20/30/40 logos; START 60 begins the initial setup; START 100 past 'Setup complete' to the title menu;
# CROSS 120 = NEW GAME (save created, intro movie); no presses during the movie.
20:0x0008 30:0x0008 40:0x0008 60:0x0008 100:0x0008 120:0x4000
# Anchor: the game's first open of Metropolis' streaming_sound.dat = control start (281 s in tods-7049-reg,

# control start, so the in-level part keeps the old script's timing relative to the level for a 280 s start.
